notes.title: Update Notes for 12-Jul-21 - Fix camera angle and 2 new Battle levels
notes.content:
Hi,

There are 2 changes in this update:

1) Reverted the camera angle to the original after it was accidentally changed.

2) When both players die at the same time in a battle, the dialog now shows the result as a draw.

3) Added 2 new Battle levels.

There are more updates coming.

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

notes.title: Update Notes for 05-Jul-21 - Kicking Bombs change, multiple BG music tracks
notes.content:
Hi,

There are a few change in this update.

1) Kicking bombs is now unlimited again, with one difference that you can only kick one bomb at a time. That is, you have to wait for a bomb you kicked to explode before you an kick another.

2) There are now a few background music tracks that rotate each time you start a level.

3) Added a 'Controls' option on the front menu to explain game controls. Also added to the in game menu and the level editor screens.

4) Made various UI enhancements to make navigating with mouse and/or gamepad easier. 

There are more updates coming.

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

notes.title: Update Notes for 24-May-21 #2 - Kicking Bombs is now limited
notes.content:
Hi,

There is one change in this update.

1) Originally there was no limit to how many times you could kick bombs. Now the kick function is a pickup function. 

There are more updates coming.

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

notes.title: Update Notes for 24-May-21
notes.content:
Hi,

There are 5 changes in this update.

1) Community levels have been disabled as unfortunately I don't have the time to moderate them. You can still create and play your own custom levels. You can also play your custom levels in local and online battle modes (if you are the host). 

2) The 'Charging' enemy has been changed to now throw a bone at you when they see you instead of charging.

3) There is now a large double sized enemy that will charge at you when it sees you. It takes 2 bomb explosions to kill this enemy.

4) There's been a fix of various bugs with the UI such as not being able to change avatar using the mouse. 

5) The music track has been changed, but I'm trying to find a few different tracks so it's not so repetitive. 

As I get time I will create more 'story mode' levels. 

There are more updates coming.

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

notes.title: Update Notes for 17-Mar-21 - Support for 'azerty' keyboard
notes.content:
Hi,

There is one change in this update.

1) Added support for 'azerty' keyboard. You can now use these keys to control Player 1:
LEFT = A / Q
RIGHT = D
UP = W / Z
DOWN = s
DROP BOMB = G / SPACE
KICK BOMB = H / Right or Left Alt

You can also use these alternative keys to navigate the menus.

There are more updates coming.

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

notes.title: Update Notes for 16-Mar-21 - Big enemies / Kick bomb changes
notes.content:
Hi,

There are 2 changes in this update.

1) There is a new enemy type that is 1.5x bigger than a normal enemy and must be bombed twice to be killed. The enemy will also run in your direction if it sees you.

2) Kicked bombs travel slightly slower now. Also, you cannot kick a bomb once it's started flashing (as suggested by the community).

There are more updates coming.

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

notes.title: Update Notes for 14-Mar-21 - PvP Region Selection / Custom Level Moderation
notes.content:
Hi,

There are 2 changes in this update:

1) When playing online PvP you can now select which regional server you want to connect to (ie: "EU", "US", "ASIA", etc). Please note that you can only see your friends that are connected to the same regional server as you are. 

2) Custom levels will now have to be approved by our review team (ok 'me', lol) before they are made available to other users to play. You can still play your own levels (including online PvP with a friend) before they are made public. 

There are no new steps to follow, just publish your level and within 24-48 hours it should be approved. You can check the approval status of your level from the 'Approved' checkbox in the level editor.

There are more updates coming. 

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

notes.title: Update Notes for 11-Mar-21 - Enemies Bomb Logic
notes.content:
Hi,

There are 2 changes in this update:

1) Fixed a bug where enemies would get confused and keep standing next to bombs when they touched them. (They should of been choosing a random direction to walk in).

2) Made a change so enemies will walk away from bombs before they collide with them. The enemy needs to be approximately 2 squares away from the bomb to see it. The enemy only avoids bombs that are directly in front of them.

There are more updates coming.

Thank you for your patience and interest in Bomber Dudes!

tags.balance_change: Made a change so enemies will walk away from bombs before they collide with them.

notes.title: Update Notes for 09-Mar-2021 (Level statistics and ratings)
notes.content:
Hi, 

The community asked for the ability to rate levels created by the community. In the 'User Levels' list, you will now see the number of likes / dislikes each level has.

Currently, users can only like/dislike a level after they have completed the level. 

You will also see some statistics about the levels you have played such as "Played #", "Won #", "Best Time" and "Last Played". 

I am hoping to start releasing more game play updates very soon.

Thank you for your interest in Bomber Dudes!
